The cutoff CV is a tenth of the knob's travel per volt (OnePole.cpp:61 and 66), and because the knob spans 5Hz to 22kHz, which is about 12.1 octaves, that is about 1.2 octaves per volt rather than the one octave the sister module Filter is scaled to.
